purpose: Gems whose use pays a share of one of the player's pools, which PoB has the number for and counts as no cost at all: it is neither in the skill's Cost nor in any degen, so nothing in PoB's output says the build is paying it. optimizer/self_cost.py turns each entry into SelfCostPerSecond = fraction x pool x the main skill's uses per second (PoB's Speed), which is in the rails' idle-recovery relation. A gem enters this file only with the PoB data file and stat id that carry the number; the fraction is read there, never from memory.

gems.name: Sacrifice
gems.source: PoB v2.67.2 Data/Skills/sup_int.lua, skills["SupportSacrifice"]: the stat is 20 at every gem level, and its statMap turns the sacrificed life into Multiplier:SacrificePercent, which feeds ChaosMin/ChaosMax only. The pool is the mod's own: PercentStat stat = LifeUnreserved.
gems.note: From the user's reading of poison_spark s1 (2026-09-18): ours took Spark + Sacrifice + Cruelty + Unbound Ailments + Spell Echo where the author had Faster Projectiles + Efficacy, because the support was pure damage in PoB's numbers. At 5.35 casts per second it pays 20% of the life pool per cast.
